login.title: Anmelden
login.error: Fehler beim Anmelden. Bitte überprüfe deinen Benutzernamen und dein Passwort.
login.throttled: Too many login attempts. Please wait and try again later.
login.tos: Durch die Verwendung von PRUNplanner erklärst du dich mit den {tos_link} einverstanden.

registration.title: Kontoinformationen
registration.tos: PRUNplanner kann kostenlos verwendet werden. Mit der Erstellung eines Kontos bestätigst und stimmst du den {tos_link} zu.

result.ok_message: Registrierung erfolgreich. Du kannst dich jetzt bei PRUNplanner anmelden.
result.fix_fields: Please fix the fields marked below.
result.throttled: Too many registration attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
result.unknown: Unknown error. Please try again later.

form.username_info: Muss mindestens 3 Zeichen lang sein. Kann keine Leerzeichen enthalten.
form.password_info: At least 8 characters, not only numbers, and not a common password.
form.email_info: Only used to reset your password if you forget it. No newsletters, never shared. You can add it later in Profile.
form.email_invalid: This doesn't look like an email address. Leave it empty or fix it to create your account.
form.question: Gib den Namen des Planeten {planet} ein. Um ihn zu finden, öffne ein neues Fenster in Prosperous Universe mit dem Befehl {command}. Du siehst den Planetennamen unter 'Name' in den Planeten-Informationen

password_reset.title: Passwort zurücksetzen
password_reset.info: Bitte gib den an deine E-Mail gesendeten Code zusammen mit deinem neuen Passwort sein.
password_reset.throttled: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

request_password_reset.title: Anfrage zum Zurücksetzen des Passworts
request_password_reset.info: Gib deine E-Mail-Adresse ein, die du zuvor mit deinem PRUNplanner Konto verifiziert hast. Wenn wir sie erkennen, senden wir dir einen Code zum Zurücksetzen des Passworts zu.
request_password_reset.throttled: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
request_password_reset.error: The request failed. Please try again later.

verify_email.title: E-Mail-Verifizierung
verify_email.info: Bitte gib den Verifizierungscode ein, den du per E-Mail erhalten hast. Prüfe ggf. deinen Spam-Ordner.

result.already_verified: Your email address is already confirmed.

none.title: Add an email so you can't get locked out
none.body: If you ever forget your password, an email is the only way back to your plan. It is only used for password resets: no newsletters, never shared. | If you ever forget your password, an email is the only way back to your {count} plans. It is only used for password resets: no newsletters, never shared.
none.body_plain: If you ever forget your password, an email is the only way back to your plans. It is only used for password resets: no newsletters, never shared.

unconfirmed.title: Confirm your email
unconfirmed.body: Password resets only go to a confirmed address. Enter the code we sent to {email}, or ask for a new one.

email_nudge.never_toast: No more reminders. You can add an email any time in Profile.
email_nudge.code_sent: Code sent. Check your inbox, and your spam folder.

email_dialog.email_info: Only used to reset your password. No newsletters, never shared. You can change or remove it any time in Profile.
email_dialog.email_code_info: We'll send an 8-character code to confirm it's yours.
email_dialog.code_info: We sent a code to {email}. It's valid for 24 hours. You can also click the link in the email, on any device.
email_dialog.done_info: If you forget your password, use “Forgot password” on the login screen and we'll send the reset to {email}.
email_dialog.confirmed_toast: Email confirmed. Password resets now go to {email}.

errors.email_taken: This address is already used by another account.
errors.invalid_email: This doesn't look like an email address.
errors.invalid: That code didn't work. Check it, or send a new one.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.no_code: There is no code waiting for this account. Send a new one.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
